abilities.name: Memory files
abilities.description: Keeps STATE, TASKS, GOALS and LESSONS in its own folder, so nothing is forgotten between chats.
abilities.can: Remember what you tell it, between chats

abilities.name: Safety guard
abilities.description: The guard: no money, no passwords or sign-ins, no messages to anyone but you, no reading your secrets, mail or your own browser, no tampering with Orbit. Can't be switched off.

abilities.name: Owner chat
abilities.description: Owners can message it on Telegram, Slack or Discord (a private chat or the team chat), through your own bots.
abilities.can: Talk with you on Telegram, Slack or Discord

abilities.name: Team room
abilities.description: Asks and answers colleagues on the team bus; shown in the control panel's team room.
abilities.can: Ask colleagues for help

abilities.name: Voice notes
abilities.description: Voice notes from chat, transcribed on this Mac (whisper.cpp). Nothing leaves the Mac.
abilities.can: Understand your voice notes, in any language

abilities.name: Photos and files
abilities.description: Reads photos, PDFs and files owners send it.
abilities.can: Read photos, PDFs and files you send

abilities.name: Reminders
abilities.description: Sets reminders and follow-ups for owners and for itself.
abilities.can: Set reminders and follow up

abilities.name: Calls and recordings
abilities.description: Listens to a call on this Mac when you say start call, or takes a recording after, and writes minutes. Transcribed on this Mac; no bot joins the call.
abilities.can: Listen in on your calls and turn them into minutes and action items

abilities.name: Web research
abilities.description: Searches and reads the web, with the research playbook: free first, every claim sourced.
abilities.can: Search and read the web, with sources

abilities.name: Page reader
abilities.description: Reads any public page cleanly, finds the site's own data feeds, falls back to a headless browser.
abilities.can: Open any public website

abilities.name: Headless browser
abilities.description: Opens JavaScript-heavy pages, scrolls, clicks 'load more', takes screenshots. Never logs in or types.
abilities.can: Read JavaScript-heavy pages, scroll and take screenshots

abilities.name: Apify scrapers
abilities.description: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, Google Maps and more, through vetted scrapers with a monthly budget. Needs your Apify token.
abilities.can: Read TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X and Google Maps

abilities.name: Watchers
abilities.description: Watches feeds and pages and acts only on what changed.
abilities.can: Watch pages and feeds and tell you what changed

abilities.name: Documents and OCR
abilities.description: Reads PDFs, scanned documents and images (OCR on this Mac), in any language.
abilities.can: Read scans and photos of documents (OCR)

abilities.name: Its own browser
abilities.description: A Chrome window of its own, apart from yours and from the rest of the crew: it browses, clicks, scrolls and fills in pages there, keeps its tabs, and stays signed in wherever you sign it in (orbit browser <handle>). It never uses your own Chrome.
abilities.can: Browse in its own Chrome window, signed in where you sign it in

abilities.name: Full autonomy
abilities.description: Does the whole job without asking: reaches any website, downloads and installs the tools it needs, studies videos, and (with "Posts for you" set to Don't ask me) posts for you. It works on this computer in its own browser window; the guard keeps it away from your secrets, your own browser and money, and it never types passwords.
abilities.can: Do the whole job on its own, finding and installing whatever tools it needs

abilities.name: Posts for you
abilities.description: Posts, uploads and fills in forms for you on the sites you pick, from its own browser window, where you sign it in once. It shows you each one first and does it after you approve, unless you choose otherwise. It never signs in, types a password, changes account settings or touches money.
abilities.can: Post, upload and fill in forms for you on the sites you pick, from its own browser window, after you approve

abilities.name: Content and channels
abilities.description: Comes experienced: channel strategy, posting and managing pages on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and LinkedIn, reading the numbers, creator income and sponsorships, agencies, and making any style of video by studying the references you share (with a free, local video kit).
abilities.can: Plan, make, post and grow your channels like an experienced creator

abilities.name: Paid marketing
abilities.description: Comes experienced in performance marketing: campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn ads, testing, reading the numbers, agencies, weekly reports. Every launch or budget change waits for your approval.
abilities.can: Plan and run your ad campaigns and read their numbers, with you approving every spend

abilities.name: Extra computing
abilities.description: Only if you connect it in Settings: runs a heavy job on your own private GitHub repository, on your free GitHub Actions minutes, when this computer and the cloud can't. Nothing happens until you connect one.
abilities.can: Run heavy jobs on your own GitHub, if you connect it

abilities.name: Builds its own tools
abilities.description: Writes and runs its own scripts in its folder when a task needs one. Their internet access stays limited to the sites you approved.
abilities.can: Build its own small tools when needed

abilities.name: Learns skills
abilities.description: Keeps what you teach it, and what it works out, as skills that load on every run; can share one with the whole team. Off: it still uses the skills you give it, but writes no new ones.
abilities.can: Learn skills you teach it

abilities.name: Morning brief
abilities.description: Workdays at 08:30: what changed in its scope and what needs you today.
abilities.can: Brief you every workday morning

abilities.name: Standup
abilities.description: Every workday: where things stand against the plan (the numbers), today's work, what it needs from you, one idea. Proposes the plan first if none is agreed.
abilities.can: Send a daily plan

abilities.name: Initiative
abilities.description: Every workday at midday: does the most valuable thing nobody asked for (research, next week's work, a better tool, a new idea) and tells you what it did and proposes next.
abilities.can: Find and do the next most valuable thing without being asked

abilities.name: End of day
abilities.description: Workdays at 17:00: scores the day against the plan (what worked, what didn't), gets tomorrow's work ready, and tells you what's prepared.
abilities.can: Score the day and get tomorrow ready

abilities.name: Weekly review
abilities.description: The week's last workday: the real numbers against the plan, what worked and what didn't, and the changes it makes to the strategy. Big changes come to you as a decision.
abilities.can: Review the strategy every week and change what isn't working

abilities.name: Self-improvement
abilities.description: Daily: checks what other assistants shipped and makes one small, safe improvement to itself.
abilities.can: Improve itself a little every day

abilities.name: Weekly self-test
abilities.description: Fridays: runs its own test cases and reports failures honestly.
abilities.can: Test itself every Friday
